# Photok

> Photok is a free, open-source private photo vault. It encrypts photos and videos on-device with AES-256, requires no account and no cloud upload, and is published under the Apache License 2.0. Optional premium features are available as "Photok Pro" via a one-time in-app purchase on Google Play.

Key facts:

- **What it is:** a mobile app (package id `dev.leonlatsch.photok`) that stores photos and videos in an encrypted local vault.
- **Encryption:** AES-256. Files are decrypted only in memory while the app is in use; they are never written unprotected to disk.
- **Privacy model:** no account, no cloud upload, no ads. Media never leaves the device.
- **Analytics:** privacy-friendly, anonymized analytics via TelemetryDeck — disabled by default in open-source builds (F-Droid, GitHub), enabled by default in the Google Play build. Never used for advertising or cross-app tracking.
- **License:** Apache License 2.0 for the core app. The Google Play build may include additional proprietary Photok Pro components not covered by that license.
- **Author:** Leon Latsch, Germany. Contact: hello@photok.app
- **Availability:** Google Play, F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, GitHub Releases.
- **Languages:** community-translated into 13 languages.
- **Source code:** https://github.com/leonlatsch/Photok

## Features

- Private gallery — import photos and videos into an encrypted gallery and organize them into albums.
- AES-256 encryption — every file is strongly encrypted; decryption happens only in memory.
- Biometric unlock — open the vault with fingerprint authentication.
- Encrypted backups — create and restore encrypted backups of the vault.
- Auto-delete originals — optionally remove source files after import.
- Share & export — share into the vault from other apps, or export files on your own terms.
- Hide the app icon — optionally remove the launcher icon for extra discretion.
- Intruder warnings (Photok Pro) — opt-in; takes a camera photo on a failed unlock attempt, stored locally only and never transmitted.

## Download

- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.leonlatsch.photok): includes optional Photok Pro in-app purchase.
- [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/dev.leonlatsch.photok/): fully open-source build, analytics off by default.
- [IzzyOnDroid](https://apt.izzysoft.de/fdroid/index/apk/dev.leonlatsch.photok): third-party F-Droid repository.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/leonlatsch/Photok/releases/latest): signed APKs directly from the project.
